candidates.name: Crunches
candidates.cardText:
Crunches
Novice
1
Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground, about a foot from your lower back.
2
Place your fingertips on your temples with your palms facing out.
3
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor. Return to starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Laying Leg Raises
candidates.cardText:
Laying Leg Raises
Novice
1
Lay on your back with your arms palms down on either side.
2
Keep your legs together and as straight as possible.
3
Slowly raise your legs to a 90° angle, pause at this position, or as high as you can reach your legs, and then slowly lower your legs back down.
4
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

candidates.name: Long Lever Plank
candidates.cardText:
Long Lever Plank
Advanced
1
Start in a hand plank position and walk your hands further out until your ears are between your biceps.
2
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
3
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

candidates.name: Hanging Knee Raises
candidates.cardText:
Hanging Knee Raises
Beginner
1
Grab the bar and hang, your body still and your legs straight.
2
Slowly draw your knees up to your chest
3
Once you have raised your knees as high as possible, lower your legs and repeat. Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
4
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

candidates.name: Forearm Plank
candidates.cardText:
Forearm Plank
Novice
1
Place forearms on the ground with your elbows bent at a 90° angle aligned beneath your shoulders, with your arms parallel at shoulder-width.
2
Your feet should be together, with only your toes touching the floor.
3
Lift your belly off the floor and form a straight line from your heels to the crown of your head and hold.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Hand Plank Jack
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Hand Plank Jack
Beginner
1
Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
2
Jump hands outward simultaneously while keeping feet planted and core tight.
3
Jump hands back under shoulders, maintaining stable hips and spine.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Feet Plank Jack
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Feet Plank Jack
Beginner
1
Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
2
Jump feet out wide while bracing core and keeping hips level.
3
Jump feet back together, maintaining plank alignment throughout.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Feet Down Russian Twist
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Feet Down Russian Twist
Novice
1
Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, and clasp hands at chest.
2
Rotate torso to one side without lifting feet.
3
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Crunch
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Stability Ball Crunch
Beginner
1
Start by lying flat on your back on a ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
2
Engage your core muscles and flex your spine until you feel your abs contract.

candidates.name: Stability Ball Stir The Pot
candidates.cardText:
Stability Ball Stir The Pot
Intermediate
1
Kneel behind a stability ball, place forearms on top, and engage your core muscles.
2
Lift knees, balance on toes, and slowly move forearms in small controlled circles.
3
Maintain a stable torso, avoid excessive movement, and reverse direction after several rotations.

candidates.name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
candidates.cardText:
Stability Ball Knee Tuck
Intermediate
1
Start in a plank position with your feet on a stability ball and hands on the floor.
2
Engage your core and tuck your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball forward carefully.
3
Extend your legs back to the starting position, maintaining balance and control throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Stability Ball Pike
candidates.cardText:
Stability Ball Pike
Intermediate
1
Place your feet on the ball and get in to a plank position.
2
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
3
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

candidates.name: Stability Ball Atomic Push Up
candidates.cardText:
Stability Ball Atomic Push Up
Intermediate
1
Place feet on a stability ball, hands on the floor in a push-up position.
2
Lower your chest toward the floor, then push up while tucking knees toward your chest.
3
Extend legs back to starting position, maintaining control and stability throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Stability Ball Windshield Wiper
candidates.cardText:
Stability Ball Windshield Wiper
Intermediate
1
Lie on your back, legs extended, stability ball between your feet, arms out for support.
2
Engage your core, lift your legs, and rotate them side to side in a controlled motion.
3
Keep your upper body stable, move slowly, and return to center before switching directions.

candidates.name: Stability Ball V Up Pass
candidates.cardText:
Stability Ball V Up Pass
Intermediate
1
Lie on your back, holding a stability ball between your feet, arms extended overhead.
2
Engage your core, lift your legs and arms, passing the ball from feet to hands.
3
Lower arms and legs back down, then repeat, passing the ball back to feet.

candidates.name: Hanging L Sit
candidates.cardText:
Hanging L Sit
Intermediate
1
Hang from a bar with arms fully extended.
2
Lift legs to form an "L" shape.
3
Hold for allotted amount of time keeping your abs flexed.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Plank Arm Lift
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Plank Arm Lift
Beginner
1
Start in a plank position.
2
Raise your arm out in front of you.
3
Return to the starting position, then raise the opposing arm.
4
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Plank Jack
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Plank Jack
Beginner
1
Start in a plank position, hands under shoulders, body straight.
2
Jump feet wide, then back together, like a jumping jack.
3
Keep core tight, maintain plank form, repeat for desired time or reps.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Hanging Knee Tuck
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Hanging Knee Tuck
Intermediate
1
Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
2
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
3
Lower legs back down, maintain controlled movement.

candidates.name: Bodyweight Hanging L Sit
candidates.cardText:
Bodyweight Hanging L Sit
Beginner
1
Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
2
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
3
Hold that position for the specified amount of time.

candidates.name: Reverse Crunch Kick Up
candidates.cardText:
Reverse Crunch Kick Up
Intermediate
1
Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
2
Flex at the hips and knees until your hips land back on the bench, then kick your legs back out to the starting position.

candidates.name: Eccentric Dragonflag
candidates.cardText:
Eccentric Dragonflag
Intermediate
1
Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
2
With your hips and knees extended, lower yourself slowly back to the start position.

candidates.name: Laying Alternating Leg Raise
candidates.cardText:
Laying Alternating Leg Raise
Novice
1
Lie on your back, arms by sides, legs straight.
2
Lift one leg to a 45-degree angle.
3
Lower leg, lift opposite leg; alternate smoothly.

candidates.name: Laying Bent Leg Raise
candidates.cardText:
Laying Bent Leg Raise
Novice
1
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
2
Raise both knees towards your chest.
3
Lower back down without touching the floor; repeat for desired reps.

candidates.name: Alternating Bent Leg Raise
candidates.cardText:
Alternating Bent Leg Raise
Novice
1
Lie on your back, legs bent and lifted off the ground.
2
Lower one leg to the ground until your foot taps the ground, keep your other leg up.
3
Alternate sides for the prescribed amount of reps.

candidates.name: Scissor Kick
candidates.cardText:
Scissor Kick
Novice
1
Lie on your back, hands under your buttocks or on the ground for support.
2
Lift legs off the ground, alternate crossing them in a scissor motion.

candidates.name: Sideways Scissor Kick
candidates.cardText:
Sideways Scissor Kick
Beginner
1
Lift both legs off the ground.
2
Bring both legs outward, then cross both legs over one another.
3
Alternating which leg goes on top.

candidates.name: Reach And Catch
candidates.cardText:
Reach And Catch
Novice
1
Lay flat on your back with both hands over one leg.
2
Reach toward your knee flexing your abs and obliques.
3
Do the prescribed amount of reps, then switch sides.

candidates.name: Frog Crunch
candidates.cardText:
Frog Crunch
Beginner
1
Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind head.
2
Crunch up, flexing the spine and your abs.

candidates.name: Frog Sit Up
candidates.cardText:
Frog Sit Up
Beginner
1
Lay on your back with knees bent and your feet together.
2
Keep your arms extended overhead. Swing your arms to generate some momentum and sit up.

candidates.name: Elbow Plank Mountain Climber
candidates.cardText:
Elbow Plank Mountain Climber
Beginner
1
Begin in an elbow plank position with your core engaged.
2
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow.
3
Return to plank, then switch legs quickly. Repeat.

candidates.name: Slow Tempo Mountain Climber
candidates.cardText:
Slow Tempo Mountain Climber
Novice
1
To perform a bodyweight mountain climber, start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
2
Bring your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot close to your hand. Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest.
3
Continue this movement, alternating legs, at a slow pace for a set amount of time or repetitions.

candidates.name: Switch Jump Mountain Climber
candidates.cardText:
Switch Jump Mountain Climber
Intermediate
1
Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders.
2
Jump one foot forward, switch legs mid-air.
3
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady plank.

candidates.name: Slalom Mountain Climber
candidates.cardText:
Slalom Mountain Climber
Intermediate
1
Start in a plank position with hands directly under shoulders.
2
Drive knees toward left elbow.
3
Go back to starting position, then drive knees to right elbow, mimicking a zigzag slalom motion.

candidates.name: Jumping Mountain Climber
candidates.cardText:
Jumping Mountain Climber
Beginner
1
Begin in a plank position, hands under shoulders, feet together.
2
Jump feet forward, landing outside hands in a low squat.
3
Explode back to plank, repeat continuously for desired reps.

candidates.name: Ring Standing Roll Out
candidates.cardText:
Ring Standing Roll Out
Intermediate
1
Grasp the rings, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
2
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
3
Slowly lower your body down toward the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
4
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.
